name: compass
description: Evidence-based development workflow: spec before code, gates that run real commands instead of letting the AI declare its own results.

interface.shortDescription: Spec before code, and gates that decide when the work is done
interface.longDescription: Compass makes every claim of done carry evidence. The agent writes the spec, the code and the tests; Compass runs them, checks every spec case actually ran, signs the record and decides pass or fail.
defaultPrompt: Add a feature to this project with Compass.
Fix this bug and prove it with Compass gates.
